title: Loi du 22 décembre 2014 portant Code de procédure pénale
publisher: Ministère de la Justice des Comores
why_not: A 2014 law, before the 2019 floor: it requires procès-verbaux drawn up on the spot and signed on each sheet (art. 58) and a custody register in every police and gendarmerie premises, but names no medium and states no practice; no term for electronic or handwritten appears in it.
